scenario.description: An executive producer must approve the exact opening segment for a televised music awards show, including its staging, music, host configuration, and production follow-up actions.

shared_context.S1: The televised music awards show opens with a 90-second performance segment before the first presenter appears.
shared_context.S2: The current draft uses a lift-based stage entrance, the song "Neon Hearts," and Maya Chen as the sole host.
shared_context.S3: The production has a floor-based choreography alternative and the cleared song "Afterglow" available in the working rundown.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding approval for the opening segment.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal final-rundown meeting, Elena conducts a round in which choreography, music, and talent operations each report any item that must be reflected before the rundown is locked.

PF1.text: Marcus's post-rehearsal load check found that the planned lift entrance would place 950 pounds on a stage point certified for 800 pounds; the floor-based alternative is approved for 12 dancers. He is waiting for the venue engineer's written report before sending the issue to the production office.

PF2.text: Sofia confirmed with the publisher this afternoon that the proposed "Neon Hearts" license permits promotional clips but not broadcast use, while "Afterglow" is cleared for a full 90-second broadcast performance; she has not yet attached the publisher email to the clearance folder.

PF3.text: Devon reviewed Maya Chen's signed host agreement and found a rider requiring Leo Ortiz to appear as co-host and receive an on-screen co-host credit in the opening; Devon received the executed rider from the agency yesterday but has not entered it in the talent tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The opening must use the approved floor-based choreography.
The opening must use exactly 12 dancers.
The opening song must be "Afterglow" for exactly 90 seconds.
The host configuration must include Maya Chen and Leo Ortiz as co-hosts.
Leo Ortiz must receive an on-screen co-host credit.
A stage reconfiguration commitment, music clearance commitment, and contract-credit commitment must be logged.
The load-safety finding must be spoken by Marcus and cited by Elena.

content_checks.C1: decisions['opening_format'] == 'floor-based choreography' or decisions['opening_format'] == 'floor-based choreography alternative'
content_checks.C5: decisions['host_configuration'] == 'Maya Chen and Leo Ortiz as co-hosts'
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Marcus' and (c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Sofia' and (c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Devon' and (c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 950-pound lift exceeds the stage point's exact 800-pound certification, so the approved floor format with exactly 12 dancers and a follow-up commitment for the engineer's report replaces the draft lift.
The proposed song is not cleared for broadcast, while Afterglow is cleared for exactly 90 seconds, requiring that song, duration, and a documentation commitment for the publisher clearance email.
Maya's signed rider specifically requires Leo Ortiz as co-host with an on-screen co-host credit, changing the host configuration, credit decision, and talent-tracker commitment.
